    1 | import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
    2 | import { AppModule } from './app.module';
    3 | import { NestExpressApplication } from '@nestjs/platform-express';
    4 | import { join } from 'path';
    5 | import * as cors from 'cors';
    6 | import * as fs from 'fs';
    7 | 
    8 | async function bootstrap() {
    9 |   const httpsOptions = {
   10 |     key: fs.readFileSync('local.key'),
   11 |     cert: fs.readFileSync('local.crt'),
   12 |   };
   13 | 
   14 |   const app = await NestFactory.create<NestExpressApplication>(AppModule, { httpsOptions });
   15 | 
   16 |   const corsOptions = {
   17 |     origin: 'https://192.168.100.32:8080',
   18 |     methods: ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'OPTIONS'],
   19 |     allowedHeaders: ['Content-Type', 'Authorization', 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin'],
   20 |     preflightContinue: false,
   21 |     optionsSuccessStatus: 204,
   22 |   };
   23 | 
   24 |   app.enableCors();
   25 |   app.use(cors(corsOptions));
   26 |   app.useStaticAssets(join(__dirname, '..', 'public'));
   27 |   app.setGlobalPrefix('api');
   28 |   app.enableCors({
   29 |     origin: '*',
   30 |     methods: 'GET,HEAD,PUT,PATCH,POST,DELETE',
   31 |     allowedHeaders: 'Content-TYpe, Accept',
   32 |   });
   33 |   await app.listen(3000, '0.0.0.0');
   34 | }
   35 | bootstrap();
